today.heading.note: The question she came with, as she would ask it.

today.free-count.note: A count first: she reads a number faster than a list.

today.free-count-one.note: The singular, written out: never "1 rooms".

today.free-until.note: Until when is what she checks before she sends anyone.

today.book-room.note: The action names the room, so that she never books the one beside it.

today.not-free.note: One name for busy, being cleaned and closed.

today.not-free-caption.note: Says the order, so that the first row is the answer when nothing is free.

today.busy-row.note: First names, and the initial of the patient's surname: never a full name at the counter.

today.cleaning-row.note: When it is ready, not that it is being cleaned.

today.last-updated.note: She does not trust a status she cannot date.

today.none-free.note: Says it plainly, and "now": something frees up soon.

today.frees-first.note: The answer to her next question, before she asks it.

today.book-from.note: The same action, from the time the room frees up.

today.booked.note: What she says aloud to the patient.

today.undo-hint.en: You can take this back for two minutes
today.undo-hint.note: Says how long, so that she does not hunt for it later.

today.not-saved.note: What happened, with no reason she cannot act on.

today.try-again.note: The one thing she can do about it.
